welcome: 👋 Welcome to the marketplace! Browse shops, order, and pay on delivery.
switched_shop: Your cart had items from another shop, so it was cleared.
ask_phone: 📞 Send your phone number (button below or type it, e.g. 0911223344):
bad_phone: That doesn't look like an Ethiopian number. Try 09XXXXXXXX.
ask_location: 📍 Send your delivery location pin, or type your address and landmark:
ask_landmark: Now type a landmark/description (e.g. 'Bole, near Edna Mall, 3rd floor'):
order_placed: 🎉 Order {code} placed! The seller will confirm shortly.
sell_intro: Let's open your shop. What is your shop name?
reg_slug: Choose a short link name (a-z, 0-9, _ ; 3-30 chars). Your link will be t.me/{bot}?start=shop_NAME
slug_taken: That name is taken, try another.
reg_done: ✅ Shop submitted! You'll be notified once an admin approves it.
shop_pending: Your shop is waiting for admin approval.
shop_approved: 🎉 Your shop {name} is approved! Open /start → Sell / My shop to add products.
shop_rejected: Your shop {name} was not approved. Contact support.
send_photo: 📷 Send a product photo. Tip: add a caption like Nike shoes | 3500 | 10 (title | price | stock) to skip questions.
bad_number: Please send a valid positive number.
pay_choose: 💳 How would you like to pay?
pay_instructions: 💳 Pay {amount} to: {provider} {number} 👤 {holder} Then send me the transaction reference (or a screenshot with the reference as caption). ⏱ Pay within {minutes} min · Order {code} /cancel to leave this screen (order stays open).
pay_bad_format: That doesn't look like a valid {provider} reference ({hint}). Check it and send again.
pay_ask_ref: Screenshot received 👍 Now please type the transaction reference too.
pay_duplicate: ⛔ This reference was already used for another order.
pay_already: This reference was already submitted for this order — please wait.
pay_too_many: Too many failed attempts on this order. Please contact support.
pay_verified: ✅ Payment verified! Order {code} was sent to the seller.
pay_review: 🔎 We couldn't verify this automatically, so the seller was asked to confirm it. You'll be notified.
pay_rejected:
❌ Payment not accepted: {reason}.
You can send another reference.
rej_amount_low: the amount is lower than the order total
rej_wrong_receiver: it was paid to a different account
rej_too_old: this payment is older than the order. Place the order first, then pay, then send the reference
seller_confirmed_buyer: ✅ The seller confirmed your payment for order {code}.
seller_denied_buyer: ⚠️ The seller says payment for order {code} hasn't arrived. Check your reference, send it again, or open a dispute.
dispute_opened: Dispute opened. Our team will review it and contact you.
order_expired: ⌛ Order {code} was cancelled because payment wasn't received in time.
no_methods: This shop has no payment method set up yet.
accounts_title: 💳 Payment accounts Buyers pay you directly to these accounts. 💵 Cash on delivery: {cod}
acc_ask_holder: Account holder name (exactly as on the account):
acc_bad_number: That number looks invalid. Try again.
cod_need_account: Add a payment account before turning off cash on delivery.
review_none: No payments are waiting for your confirmation.
zones_title: 🚚 Delivery zones\nBuyers pick a zone at checkout and the fee is added to their total.\nNo zones = free delivery everywhere.
zone_ask_name: Zone name (e.g. Bole, Hawassa, Pickup at shop):
zone_preset_fee: Delivery fee for ALL Addis Ababa sub-cities (ETB, 0 = free):
zone_preset_done: ✅ Added {n} Addis Ababa sub-cities. Tap a zone in the list to remove or change it.
rate_prompt: How was your experience? Please rate the seller:
rate_comment: Thanks for rating {stars}! Want to add a short comment? Type it now, or tap Skip.
plan_extra_featured: · 🌟 listed first in the shop directory
plan_not_configured: Plan payments aren't set up yet. Please contact support.
plan_review: 🔎 We couldn't verify it automatically, so an admin will confirm your payment shortly.
plan_denied: ❌ We couldn't confirm your plan payment. Check the reference and try again from 💎 My plan.
plan_limit: Your {plan} plan allows {limit} products and you have {used}. Upgrade from 💎 My plan to add more.
plan_soon: ⏰ Your {plan} plan expires in {days} day(s). Renew from 💎 My plan to keep your limits.
plan_expired: Your {plan} plan expired. You're back on the Free plan (limit {limit} products); your existing products stay.
verify_line_rejected: ❌ Verification rejected: tap Get verified to resubmit
verify_ret_deleted: The photos are deleted as soon as we decide.
verify_ret_kept: The photos are kept securely for fraud prevention.
verify_ask_name: Your full name exactly as written on the document:
verify_ask_id: 📷 Send a clear photo of the document (as a photo, not a file). All corners and text must be readable.
verify_ask_selfie: 🤳 Now send a selfie of you holding the same document next to your face.
verify_ask_license: 📄 Optional: a photo of your trade/business license if you have one, or tap Skip.
verify_need_photo: Please send a photo (not text or a file).
verify_submitted: ✅ Submitted! An admin will review it soon and you'll be notified.
verify_pending: Your verification is already under review.
verify_approved: 🎉 You're verified! The ✔️ badge now shows on your shop and it's listed above unverified shops.
verify_rejected: ❌ We couldn't verify you: {reason}. Tap ✔️ Get verified to try again.
vrej_blurry: the photo was blurry or unreadable
vrej_mismatch: the name doesn't match the document
vrej_selfie: the selfie doesn't match the document
vrej_invalid: the document is invalid or expired
report_thanks: Thanks. Our team will review your report.
report_duplicate: You already have an open report about this shop.
shop_suspended: ⛔ Your shop {name} was suspended. Please contact support.
